paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles with the Perseus Galaxy Cluster with MAGIC
notes: ALP-photon coupling limits from gamma-ray spectral irregularities of NGC 1275 in the Perseus cluster observed with MAGIC (astrophysical bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density). Main result: 99% CL exclusion constraining ALP masses 40-400 neV, most competitive for 40-90 neV, reaching g_agamma = 3e-12 GeV^-1 at m_a=40 neV. The exclusion is a 2D region; only sparse representative points quoted in the text could be extracted (e.g. down to 3e-12 GeV^-1 around 40-50 neV, ~5e-11 to 5e-10 GeV^-1 around 200 neV). Full exclusion curve is in Fig. 5 (99% CL) and not available as a table. Data points here are approximate and reflect quoted text values; the exclusion is an upper region above these coupling values.
